widgets_values: # Switch to the original image ratio/custom ratio (enabled as custom)

Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Default (custom_size off): output follows image_1's aspect ratio, scaled to about resolution*resolution (default 1024, multiple of 32). This is not image_1's original pixel size. Set resolution to 0 to keep original sizes (rounded to 32).

Turn on custom_size to use the ResolutionSelector width/height as the canvas. Keep it close to the resized image_1 size, or the edit can shift.

# 该组仅建议在想要得到对比图的情况下打开，正常编辑时将其关闭即可，可以节省大量时间。
# This group is only recommended to be enabled when you want to get comparison images. For normal editing, it can be turned off, which can save a lot of time.

## 在线使用时关闭这个开关，本地使用时打开这个开关。（如果不想生成对比图，可以不管这里。可以单独去 把对比图开关关掉）
## Turn off this switch when using it online, and turn on this switch when using it locally. (If you don’t want to generate comparison images, you can ignore this. You can separately go and turn off the comparison image switch.)

## 我更建议你直接使用系统提示词发给大语言模型，来帮你优化图像编辑指令。主要原因如下：
### 1. 本地模型速度慢：如果试图使用本地的提示词优化模型，且只使用 ComfyUI 原生的节点，它的生成速度会非常慢。
### 2. 节点安装麻烦：若想搭配第三方节点，对于新手来说安装起来可能会有一点麻烦。
### 因此，我更推荐你使用其他大语言模型搭配图像编辑的系统提示词。你只需把你想要编辑的图像和指令发给大语言模型，它就可以帮你优化编辑指令，使其符合qwen image2.1 模型的提示词格式。
# 系统提示词就在我的压缩包解压之后的那个TXT文件中。

## I recommend that you directly use system prompts to send to a large language model to help you optimize image editing instructions. The main reasons are as follows:
### 1. Local model is slow: If you try to use a local prompt optimization model and only use the native nodes of ComfyUI, its generation speed will be very slow.
### 2. Node installation is troublesome: If you want to use third-party nodes, installation might be a bit troublesome for beginners.
### Therefore, I recommend that you use other large language models together with system prompts for image editing. You only need to send the image you want to edit and the instructions to the large language model, and it can help you optimize the editing instructions to match the prompt format of the qwen image2.1 model.

# The system prompt is in the TXT file that came after I extracted my compressed file.
# Prompt optimization switch 'Use with caution on low VRAM'

## 这里用到的加速模型的下载网址:[【Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1 】](https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors)
## The download URL for the acceleration model used here:[【Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1 】](https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors)

生成输入图中角色的三视图：画面从左到右并排三个等大的全身格——正面（front view）、侧面（side view, profile）、背面（back view, rear），三格位于同一条水平基线上、头顶与脚底齐平，等宽等高、间隔均匀、互不遮挡、互不裁切，三格是同一个人物、同一套服装与配色。三格都完整入画、四周留白、人物不贴边，并与输入图保持相同的落地关系与接触阴影。人物保持与输入图完全一致：黑色齐厚刘海配黑色长发双马尾、头上戴着大号黑色毛绒猫耳，深棕色眼睛与红唇妆容，白色翻领衬衫配袖口纽扣，外搭深蓝黑色格纹针织背心（V领、深色纽扣），肤色白皙；单侧部件保持在输入图中的同一侧。体态严格按输入图呈现：胸部与腰胯的比例、身体的厚薄都与输入图一致，纤细就呈现纤细，不缩减、不扁平化、也不凭空增加；侧面格呈现身体自然的前后厚度与起伏。背面格完整呈现服装背面的结构与接缝、双马尾在背后的走向，由正面的设计自然延续、不出现正面没有的新部件。输入图在胸部以下被裁切，按同一设计语言补全为完整全身，沿用同一套配色与材质。纯色浅灰背景，均匀柔光，脚下柔和浅影。画面中不出现额外文字、水印与签名。
